name: cadence
description: High-Fidelity Studio Audio Player & Synced Karaoke Lyrics Engine
author: DRNZY

scripts.dev: npm run build:shell && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,APP" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "tsx server/index.ts" "vite" "CADENCE_DEV=1 native/cadence-bin"
scripts.build:server:native: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-server/standalone.mjs --packages=bundle --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
scripts.build:native: npm run build:client && npm run build:server:native && npm run build:shell
